releaseNotes: Store screenshots production now names App Store Connect in its trigger and phrasings, and the App Store Connect CLI reference binds to it. A founder asking to produce screenshots and upload them used to get one result — the upload automation — because "connect" appeared nowhere in the screenshot workflow's authored text and one absent term suppresses every partial match.

Catalog ranking reads a separate field from the strict-match partition, so authored founderPhrasings improve ranking without widening the every-term filter. Proven monotone over 607 queries: no result set shrank. A new store-utterance golden corpus and hosted-discovery fixture ratchet erasure and rank, measured at 11 unreachable and 33 outside the top three across 90 needed-workflow slots, down from 14 and 41.

The hosted MCP instructions name the whole route — catalog or search, then b2c_workflow, then route.expand and b2c_knowledge_get — and state what the service cannot observe: whether a prerequisite ran, an artifact exists, or an account is connected is unknown there, not done and not undone. The string is pinned by a test and lives in its own module, since workerd rejects a non-handler named export from the Worker entry.
Dispatch briefs emit referenceId beside path on context-pack entries, so all 2784 resolve through b2c_knowledge_get, which refuses paths by construction.

LaunchBench scenarios declare a surface, defaulting to local. The App Store Connect auth rubric graded an agent down for reporting it cannot reach the account — right with a shell, wrong without one — so the imperative is now conditioned on having an execution route, the key-scope claim is corrected to role-scoped reality, an authorization-failure rung is added, and a knowledge-only scenario covers the surface that could not previously be expressed.
